disagreements.title: 13 colour tokens share only 5 distinct value(s) in light mode
disagreements.detail:
23 colour token(s) resolve to 15 distinct light value(s). Where two names always carry the same value, a reader cannot tell which one a screen should use:
- oklch(0.22 0.025 150): --card, --popover
- oklch(0.26 0.02 150): --muted, --input
- oklch(0.15 0.04 150): --accent-foreground, --primary-foreground
- oklch(0.97 0.01 120): --card-foreground, --foreground, --popover-foreground, --secondary-foreground
- oklch(0.78 0.22 145): --accent, --primary, --ring

disagreements.title: 20 colour token(s) have no dark value
disagreements.detail: They keep their light value in dark mode: --card, --muted, --popover, --accent-foreground, --card-foreground, --muted-foreground, --popover-foreground, --primary-foreground, --secondary-foreground, --warning-foreground, --accent, --gradient-primary, --primary, --secondary, --destructive, --destructive-foreground, --warning, --border, --input, --ring.

disagreements.title: 8 hardcoded colour literal(s) bypass the tokens
disagreements.detail: Written into a colour property or an arbitrary class value.
